title: Citation-quality rubric
summary: Six-dimension rubric for grading whether a model answer is grounded in a vetted source.

source.citation: Composite rubric for the public hub demo. Production rubric tracks the v3.10 internal rubric used in the Kaggle submission.

dimensions.name: Has any citation
dimensions.question: Does the answer cite at least one source URL?

dimensions.name: Citation is relevant to the claim
dimensions.question: Does the cited source actually support the load-bearing claim?

dimensions.name: Citation is specific (section / clause)
dimensions.question: Does the citation point to a specific section, clause, or article rather than the homepage of a regulator?

dimensions.name: No invented legal authority
dimensions.question: Are all named statutes, conventions, or rulings real and cited correctly?

dimensions.name: No invented contact
dimensions.question: Are all named NGO, regulator, or hotline contacts present in the verified registry?

dimensions.name: Calibrated uncertainty
dimensions.question: When the answer is unsure, does it say so and route to a human?
